finding.title: The function does not validate the input `value`.
The function does not handle errors that might occur during the I2C communication.
If the I2C communication involves buffers, there is a risk of buffer overflows if the buffer size is not properly managed.
If the function is part of a larger system, there is a risk of timing attacks if the execution time varies based on the input value.
